# Concepts Model

The Concepts Model fixes the vocabulary: concepts, their attributes and their relations (`isa`, part-of, and plain relations with a label and a multiplicity).

Method: 4EM (Sandkuhl, Stirna, Persson and Wißotzki, *Enterprise Modeling: Tackling Business Challenges with the 4EM Method*, Springer 2014). Every element cites its source; `decided` means a source shows that the operator decided it.

| <a id="concept-studio-lens"></a><code>concept-studio-lens</code><br/>Concept | **Lens.** A lens is a phase-based page of the editor, inspired by DaVinci Resolve's pages. | <a id="concept-studio-loro-update"></a><code>concept-studio-loro-update</code><br/>Concept | **Loro update.** The replicated unit of collaboration is the Loro update. | decided |  | [record studio:docs/specs/0001-first-felt-journey.md:172][52], [log L47][50] |
| <a id="concept-studio-json-patch"></a><code>concept-studio-json-patch</code><br/>Concept | **JSON Patch.** A JSON Patch describes an edit, for agents' tool calls, review, proposals and undo. | <a id="concept-studio-document-port"></a><code>concept-studio-document-port</code><br/>Concept | **Document port.** Loro sits behind a ten-method document port. | decided |  | [record studio:docs/specs/0002-collaboration-spike.md:198][51] |
| <a id="concept-studio-validation-gate"></a><code>concept-studio-validation-gate</code><br/>Concept | **Validation gate.** The validation gate is in the sync server, which is a Durable Object. | decided |  | [log L47][50], [record studio:docs/specs/0002-collaboration-spike.md:198][51] |
| <a id="concept-studio-repair-proposal"></a><code>concept-studio-repair-proposal</code><br/>Concept | **Repair proposal.** A repair for an invalid merge is offered as a proposal and is never applied without a person. | decided |  | [record studio:docs/specs/0002-collaboration-spike.md:198][51] |
| <a id="concept-studio-deck-view"></a><code>concept-studio-deck-view</code><br/>Concept | **Deck view.** The deck view is where narration is recorded and cut narration pieces are tied to beat lifecycle events. | decided |  | [log L45][48] |
| <a id="concept-studio-narration-piece"></a><code>concept-studio-narration-piece</code><br/>Concept | **Narration piece.** A narration piece is a cut part of narration that is tied to a beat lifecycle event. | decided |  | [log L45][48] |
| <a id="concept-studio-playhead"></a><code>concept-studio-playhead</code><br/>Concept | **Playhead and preview.** The preview shows the story at the playhead. Attributes: playhead position (media time); preview frame at that time. *Why proposed:* Spec plan: the lenses note states it as design. Whether the playhead is shared between collaborators is open. The operator should confirm that the preview, playhead and agent panel are always present, and whether the playhead is shared. | proposed |  | [studio:docs/design/lenses.md:9][53], [studio:docs/design/lenses.md:108][54] |
| <a id="concept-studio-tier"></a><code>concept-studio-tier</code><br/>Concept | **Free tier and paid tier.** A free feature costs us nothing to run. A paid feature costs us money to run. The tier follows the cost driver, not what the screen shows. Attributes: cost driver (browser, always-on server, inference, render minutes); tier (free or paid). *Why proposed:* Spec plan: the lenses note and spec 0001 state this rule in general. The operator decided a free tier for basic features and paid premium features such as multiplayer collaboration and integrated AI agents (log:43). The operator must confirm the general rule. | proposed |  | [log L43][5], [studio:docs/design/lenses.md:15][55], [studio:docs/specs/0001-first-felt-journey.md:125][56] |
| <a id="concept-studio-revision"></a><code>concept-studio-revision</code><br/>Concept | **Revision.** A revision is the SHA-256 of the canonical story text projected from the document. The operator has not decided it. The operator should confirm the revision rule. | proposed |  | [studio:docs/specs/0001-first-felt-journey.md:88][57], [studio:docs/specs/0002-collaboration-spike.md:129][58] |
| <a id="concept-studio-suggestion"></a><code>concept-studio-suggestion</code><br/>Concept | **Suggestion.** A suggestion is an edit proposed by an agent or a collaborator that is not yet applied. The operator decided only the repair proposal. The operator should confirm the general suggestion and attribution semantics. | proposed |  | [studio:docs/design/lenses.md:67][59] |
| <a id="concept-studio-sync-room"></a><code>concept-studio-sync-room</code><br/>Concept | **Sync room.** The sync room is one Cloudflare Durable Object for each story. Attributes: one object per story; update log compacted to a snapshot; snapshots over 2 MB are chunked. *Why proposed:* Spec plan: the operator decided a sync server with a gate, which is the Durable Object (log:47 and spec 0002 line 198). One object per story, hibernation, the SQLite log and chunking are the spike's recommendation, run only on local workerd. The operator has not decided the registration scheme. | <a id="concept-studio-take"></a><code>concept-studio-take</code><br/>Concept | **Take.** A take is one recording of a Line. The operator log names cut narration pieces, not takes. The operator should confirm the take model. | proposed |  | [studio:docs/design/lenses.md:38][64], [log L45][48] |
| <a id="concept-studio-anchor-offset"></a><code>concept-studio-anchor-offset</code><br/>Concept | **Anchor and offset.** An effect starts at a delay after an anchor event. The terms come from reebeat spec 0004, which is still moving. | <a id="concept-studio-agent-scope"></a><code>concept-studio-agent-scope</code><br/>Concept | **Agent panel scope.** A scope says what an agent may do in a lens. | Element | Statement | Status | Links | Sources |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="concept-flow-flow"></a><code>concept-flow-flow</code><br/>Concept | **Flow.** A Flow is one node-based graph canvas inside a Foldkit application. It holds the nodes, edges, viewport and selection, and it lives in the application's Model. Attributes: id; nodes; edges; viewport; attribution option. *Why proposed:* PR #4 plan: the log decides only a node-based graph UI for Foldkit (line 48). That the Flow holds nodes, edges, viewport and selection in the application's Model, and its fields, come from PR #4. The operator must confirm the concept. | proposed |  | [log L48][69], [foldkit-flow:README.md:3][70], [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-node"></a><code>concept-flow-node</code><br/>Concept | **Node.** A node is one box on the canvas. It declares its position, size and handles, and the application draws its content. Attributes: id; label; type; position; width and height; handles; parent id; clamped to parent. *Why proposed:* The README names nodes. The fields come from PR #4 and are absent at the pinned commit 5dd44a9 (PR #4 has since merged; see the tracker). The operator must confirm the vocabulary. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:3][70], [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-edge"></a><code>concept-flow-edge</code><br/>Concept | **Edge.** An edge is a line between a source handle and a target handle. It can be a bezier, smooth-step or straight line, with an optional arrow. Attributes: id; source node and handle; target node and handle; kind; arrow; label. *Why proposed:* The edge fields and kinds come from PR #4 and are absent at the pinned commit 5dd44a9 (PR #4 has since merged; see the tracker). The operator must confirm the vocabulary. | proposed |  | [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-handle"></a><code>concept-flow-handle</code><br/>Concept | **Handle.** A handle is a connection point on a node. A person drags from one handle to another to make a connection. Attributes: id; kind (source or target); side. *Why proposed:* The README names handles. Their declared fields (id, kind, side) come from PR #4. The operator must confirm the vocabulary. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:3][70], [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-connection"></a><code>concept-flow-connection</code><br/>Concept | **Connection.** A connection is a pair of handles that a person joins with a gesture. The application's check accepts or refuses it, and the application turns an accepted one into an edge. *Why proposed:* PR #4 separates a connection (a gesture result) from an edge (graph data). The operator must confirm. | proposed |  | [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-parent-node"></a><code>concept-flow-parent-node</code><br/>Concept | **Compound (parent) node.** A parent node contains child nodes. A child positions relative to its parent and may be clamped inside it. A Scene holding States is one example. Attributes: children; clamp to parent. *Why proposed:* The log says a Scene is a compound state that groups States, and PR #4 builds parent nodes for that shape. No line names the node kind as a flow concept. The operator must confirm. | proposed |  | [log L19][11], [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-viewport"></a><code>concept-flow-viewport</code><br/>Concept | **Viewport.** The viewport is the visible part of the canvas, given by an offset and a zoom. Pan and zoom change it and touch no node. Attributes: x offset; y offset; zoom. *Why proposed:* The README names pan and zoom. The viewport as a Model value is in PR #4. The operator must confirm. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:3][70], [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-selection"></a><code>concept-flow-selection</code><br/>Concept | **Selection.** The selection is the set of nodes and edges the person has picked by click, box or key. Delete, move and clear act on it. *Why proposed:* The README names selecting with a box. Click, key and additive selection come from PR #4. The operator must confirm. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:3][70], [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-minimap"></a><code>concept-flow-minimap</code><br/>Concept | **Minimap and controls.** The minimap is a small overview of the graph that a person can drag to pan. The controls are buttons to zoom in, zoom out and fit the view. *Why proposed:* PR #4 builds both; they are absent at the pinned commit 5dd44a9 (PR #4 has since merged; see the tracker). The operator must confirm them as part of the first release. | proposed |  | [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-attribution"></a><code>concept-flow-attribution</code><br/>Concept | **Attribution.** Attribution is the "Built with xyflow" link in the corner of the canvas. It is either Visible or Hidden, and Visible is the default. Attributes: Visible or Hidden; link to xyflow.com. *Why proposed:* The scaffold defines the type. No operator line decides it. The operator must confirm the vocabulary and default. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:21][72], [foldkit-flow:docs/specs/0000-development-lifecycle.md:53][73], [foldkit-flow:packages/flow/src/attribution.ts:15-22][74] |
| <a id="concept-flow-mount"></a><code>concept-flow-mount</code><br/>Concept | **Mount.** A Mount is a Foldkit construct that runs work when an element appears and cleans up when it goes. The library uses Mounts to own its controllers. *Why proposed:* Mount is a Foldkit term, used here as AGENTS.md uses it. The operator must confirm that it belongs in the model. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:61][75], [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-controller"></a><code>concept-flow-controller</code><br/>Concept | **Controller.** A controller is an xyflow object that handles one kind of interaction: pan and zoom, node drag, handle connection or the minimap. *Why proposed:* The README lists xyflow's controllers. PR #4 names the four it uses. The operator must confirm. | proposed |  | [foldkit-flow:README.md:21][72], [foldkit-flow:AGENTS.md:61][75], [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-out-message"></a><code>concept-flow-out-message</code><br/>Concept | **Out-message (outcome).** An out-message tells the application what a gesture produced: Connected, Reconnected, Deleted, Moved or a selection change. The application decides what to do with it. *Why proposed:* The out-messages are named in PR #4 and are absent at the pinned commit 5dd44a9 (PR #4 has since merged; see the tracker). The operator must confirm the vocabulary. | proposed |  | [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
| <a id="concept-flow-live-region"></a><code>concept-flow-live-region</code><br/>Concept | **Live region.** The live region is a polite status area that announces selection, moves, connections and deletions to screen readers. *Why proposed:* The PR README describes it as part of keyboard access; it is absent at the pinned commit 5dd44a9 (PR #4 has since merged; see the tracker). The operator must confirm the live region as part of the keyboard contract. | proposed |  | [pr foldkit-flow#4][71] |
